name: 02 | AI Lead Qualification & CRM Automation | Production-like

parameters.content:
# 02 - AI Lead Qualification + Twenty CRM
Production-like local stack: n8n -> Twenty CRM -> Mailpit.

Twenty Person and Opportunity records include portfolio CRM fields: Lead Score, Lead Category, Service, Source, AI Summary and Request ID; Person also stores Budget and Company Size.

Independent switches: mockAI=true, mockCRM=false, mockEmail=false, mockNotification=false.

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{http_code:400,body:{status:'invalid',request_id:$json.request_id,errors:$json.validation_errors}}}];
return [{json:{http_code:$json.http_code||200,body:{status:$json.duplicate_reason,request_id:$json.request_id,previous:$json.existing_state||null}}}];

value.detail: Webhook accepted and idempotency lock acquired

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: $json.config.openAiModel, input: [ { role: 'system', content: [ { type: 'input_text', text: 'You qualify B2B automation leads. Score 0-100. Be conservative and base the result only on supplied facts.' } ] }, { role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'input_text', text: JSON.stringify({name:$json.name,email:$json.email,company:$json.company,company_size:$json.company_size,budget:$json.budget,service:$json.service,message:$json.message,source:$json.source}) } ] } ], text: { format: { type: 'json_schema', name: 'lead_qualification', strict: true, schema: { type:'object', additionalProperties:false, properties:{ score:{type:'integer',minimum:0,maximum:100}, category:{type:'string',enum:['HOT','WARM','COLD']}, intent:{type:'string'}, summary:{type:'string'}, recommended_action:{type:'string',enum:['schedule_demo','request_more_info','nurture']}, reason:{type:'string'} }, required:['score','category','intent','summary','recommended_action','reason'] } } } } }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:$json}];

const suffix=$json.request_id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g,'').slice(-12);
return [{json:{...$json,contact_id:`mock-contact-${suffix}`,contact_action:'upserted',deal_id:$json.category==='HOT'?`mock-deal-${suffix}`:'',deal_action:$json.category==='HOT'?'created':'not_required',crm_provider:'mock'}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { query: 'query FindPerson($email: String!) { people(filter: { emails: { primaryEmail: { eq: $email } } }, first: 1) { edges { node { id emails { primaryEmail } name { firstName lastName } } } } }', variables: { email: $json.email } } }}
={{ { query: 'query FindOpportunity($name: String!) { opportunities(filter: { name: { eq: $name } }, first: 1) { edges { node { id name stage } } } }', variables: { name: $json.deal_key } } }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{...$json,deal_sync_ok:true,deal_action:'existing',crm_provider:'twenty'}}];

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  name:$json.deal_key,
  amount:{amountMicros:Math.round(($json.budget||0)*1000000),currencyCode:$json.config.currencyCode},
  pointOfContactId:$json.contact_id,
  leadScore:Number($json.score||0),
  leadCategory:$json.category,
  service:String($json.service||''),
  source:String($json.source||''),
  aiSummary:String($json.summary||''),
  requestId:String($json.request_id||'')
} }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{...$json,email_status:'mock_sent',email_error:''}}];
return [{json:{...$json,notification_status:'mock_sent',notification_error:''}}];
return [{json:{...$json,status:'completed',completed_at:new Date().toISOString(),error:'',notification_status:$json.notification_status||'not_required'}}];

value.detail: ={{ `category=${$("Finalize Success").first().json.category}; score=${$("Finalize Success").first().json.score}; email=${$("Finalize Success").first().json.email_status}; notification=${$("Finalize Success").first().json.notification_status}` }}

parameters.jsCode:
const x=$('Finalize Success').first().json;
return [{json:{http_code:200,body:{status:'processed',request_id:x.request_id,category:x.category,score:x.score,contact_id:x.contact_id||null,deal_id:x.deal_id||null,email_status:x.email_status,notification_status:x.notification_status,ai_provider:x.ai_provider,ai_fallback:Boolean(x.ai_fallback)}}}];

const x=$('Build Critical Failure').first().json;
return [{json:{http_code:502,body:{status:'failed',request_id:x.request_id,error:x.critical_error}}}];
